claim: 正理（nyāya）字面义为'推理的规则或方法'；早期正理主要处理逻辑、知识论与论辩理论。
locator: IEP 导言首句：'Nyāya (literally "rule or method of reasoning") is a leading school of philosophy...'；SEP early-modern-india 导言：'the early Nyāya (grounded in Gautama Akṣapāda's Nyāya-sūtra, c. 100 C.E., and dealing mainly with logic, epistemology, and the theory of debate)'
note: 学派定位与字面义的两处独立表述。

claim: 《正理经》归名乔答摩；编成年代两来源不一（约200年／约100年）。
locator: IEP：'The oldest extant Nyāya text is the Nyāya-sūtra attributed to Gautama (c. 200 C.E.).'；SEP early-modern-india：'Gautama Akṣapāda's Nyāya-sūtra, c. 100 C.E.'（同段）
note: 两处均逐字核对；年代出入按证据分歧处理，不作调和。
uncertainty: 站内旧时间线'公元前300'未获支持；见 evidenceLimits 第1、9条。

claim: 《正理经》开篇列十六论题，分四组（知识论、形而上学、论究程序与要素、论辩术），量居首。
locator: IEP §1 首段：'The Nyāya-sūtra opens with a list of its primary topics, sixteen items which may be grouped into the following four categories: epistemology, metaphysics, procedures and elements of inquiry, and debate theory.'
note: 仅支持分组描述，不支持十六项逐一列名。
uncertainty: 十六项具体名目未逐项核对，不列举。

claim: 四量为现量、比量、譬喻量、圣言量；感知定义见 NS 1.1.4；感知为'诸量之长'。
locator: IEP：'The four pramāṇas are perception, inference, analogical reasoning, and testimony.'；'Nyāya-sūtra 1.1.4 defines perceptual cognition as follows. A perceptual cognition arises by means of the connection between sense faculty and object, is not dependent on words, is non-deviating, and is determinate.'；'perception is commonly called the jyeṣṭapramāṇa (the "eldest" knowledge source) by Nyāya'
note: 三句均逐字核对。

claim: 量的认证是外在的（parataḥ prāmāṇya），经第二级觉知（anuvyavasāya）完成；量具事实性；正理知识论被视为当代可靠主义的先驱。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'no genuine knowledge source ever produces a false belief. Only pseudo-sources do'；'Nyāya takes an extrinsicality view of certification (parataḥ prāmāṇya)'；IEP 导言：'a sophisticated precursor to contemporary reliabilism (particularly process reliabilism)'
note: anuvyavasāya 与默认信任见 SEP 同条目（'Innocent until reasonably challenged'；Matilal 1986, 314 系'证言无辜推定'的更早表述，S1 明言前者为其轻微弱化——正文归属措辞已按此修正）。
uncertainty: '可靠主义先驱'是学术类比，非历史影响。

claim: 默认信任与对怀疑论的回应：连怀疑者都依赖诸量。
locator: IEP §1（Response to Skepticism 末段）：'Given that everyone, the skeptic included, relies on pramāṇas, they are to be given the lion's share of default entitlement.'
note: 逐字核对（原文内联梵文词带空格）。

claim: 五支论式与似因：古典印度哲学家关注心理过程而非逻辑本身。
locator: IEP §1.b.ii 五支例全文（'There is fire on the hill (the pratijñā, thesis)... Thus, there is fire on the hill (the nigamana, conclusion).'）；IEP：'"pseudo provers" or logical defeaters'；SEP epistemology-india：'Classical Indian philosophers are not focused on logic per se, but rather on a psychological process'
note: 五支例为 IEP 自拟标准教学例，引语卡与结尾语系其转写。

claim: 正理与胜论11—12世纪合流成新正理；增'非存在'为第七范畴；新正理技术溢出至诗学、语言学、法理论。
locator: SEP early-modern-india 导言：'developed in parallel until, at some point in the 11th or 12th century, they merged to form a new school'；'not just by philosophers, but also in poetics, linguistics, legal theory'；第七范畴：'To Kanāḍa's original list of six categories (padārtha) or types of existent, they therefore add a seventh, "absence" (abhāva).'
note: 三处均逐字核对。

claim: 感知知识定义可能存在盖梯尔式反例的余地。
locator: SEP early-modern-india §7.1（论《推理撮要》TS 69 iii 的感知知识定义处）：'There may, however, be scope for Gettier-style counter-examples to this definition.'
note: 针对的是《推理撮要》所载感知知识定义，非泛指全部知识定义——结论措辞已限定。

claim: 《正理经》压倒性地关注理论问题而非修行，仅个别经文涉及瑜伽实践与解脱。
locator: IEP（Philosophy of Religion 节首）：'Though the Nyāya-sūtra overwhelmingly focuses on theoretical issues and not praxis, it nonetheless recommends that students of Nyāya engage in yogic practice (4.2.42) and defends the possibility of enlightenment (4.2.44-5).'
note: 学说与宗教实践之分的直接依据。

claim: 乔答摩（Gautama Akṣapāda）：归名《正理经》；早期正理根基于其经文；决定性（概念介入）感知的立场归于'经文作者本人'。
locator: SEP early-modern-india：'grounded in Gautama Akṣapāda's Nyāya-sūtra'；SEP epistemology-india：'a position taken by Gautama himself, the "sūtra-maker"'（论 NS 4.2.26–36）
note: 站内哲人名录无此人（python3 查：'乔答摩/乔达摩/足目'均无）；站内 school_印度哲学 works 条目用'乔答摩'写法，本包沿用以区分于'乔达摩·悉达多'（佛陀）。
uncertainty: 生卒无考；'足目'汉译未见于来源（evidenceLimits 第4条）。

claim: 伐差耶那：现存最古注疏家；正理方法='凭借量对对象的考察'（NB 1.1.1）；āpta 界定；反驳无穷倒退（NB 2.1.20）；tarka 为'诸量之助'。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Vātsyāyana (fourth century, whose Nyāya-sūtra commentary is the oldest extant)'；'An āpta is a person who not only knows the truth but who wants to communicate it without deception'；IEP：'"investigation of a subject by means of knowledge-sources" (NB 1.1.1)'；'"assistant to the pramāṇas" (pramāṇa-anugrahaka)'
note: 年代两来源并存（4世纪／约450）。

claim: 乌地衍那：约600年；吸收陈那学说并整合认证条件；立宽容规则；设计论式 NV 4.1.21。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Uddyotakara in his Nyāya-sūtra commentary incorporates Dignāga's ideas to formalize many of Vātsyāyana's informal inferences'；宽容规则全句见引语卡 locator；IEP：'Primordial matter, atoms and karma function when guided by a conscious agent because they are insentient (acetaṇatvāt) like an axe. ... (Uddyotakara, NV 4.1.21)'
note: IEP 系其人 c. 600；攻击瑜伽行派的记载亦见 SEP（'famous for his attacks on Yogācāra positions'）。

claim: Jayanta Bhaṭṭa：约875年；《正理蔓》为注疏链重要例外；推理与言语的成立条件不同（NM 322）。
locator: IEP 导言：'important exceptions including works of Jayanta, c. 875, Udayana, c. 975, and the somewhat heterodox Bhāsarvajña, c. 875'；SEP epistemology-india（第二轮逐字核对）：'The eighth-century Jayanta Bhaṭṭa writes (Nyāya-mañjarī 322): "The conditions that determine inferential knowledge and those that determine verbal knowledge are not the same."'
note: 汉译名未获核实，主名用拉丁转写。
uncertainty: 年代两来源略异：S1 称'eighth-century'，S2 作 c. 875；本包从 S2 的 c. 875，两说并存。

claim: Udayana：约975年；《正理花束》第五品以 kāryatvāt 立设计论式。
locator: IEP 导言（'Udayana, c. 975'）；IEP Philosophy of Religion：'Things like the earth have a maker as their cause, because they are products (kāryatvāt). (Udayana Nyāyakusumāñjali, Fifth Chapter)'
note: SEP epistemology-india 另记 Udayana 为11世纪（'Udayana (11th c.)'），与 IEP 约975年相差数十年，本包从 IEP 并在 relation 中注'其后即合流'。
uncertainty: 两来源对其年代表述略异。

claim: 陈那（Dignāga）：6世纪；系统列出因与所立的外延包含/排除关系（三相）；'两个最伟大的名字'之一。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'The two greatest names for classical Indian logic belong to logicians of the Buddhist Yogācāra school, Dignāga (sixth century) and Dharmakīrti (early seventh century).'; 'Dignāga laid out all the possible relationships of inclusion and exclusion for the extensions of two terms called the prover or "sign," hetu, and the probandum, sādhya'
note: 站内哲人名录无'陈那'（python3 查无）；作为正理论辩对手方收录，works 留空（其著作名目不在核读来源内）。

claim: 法称（Dharmakīrti）：7世纪初；按遍充关系的本体论性质给推理三分类（自性/从果/不可得）。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Dharmakīrti divides inferences into three kinds: sva-bhāva (self-nature: "It's a tree because it's a śiṃśapā oak") tad-utpatti (causality: "Fire is there because smoke is there") anupalabdhi (non-perception: "There is no pot here because none is perceived")'
note: 同上，站内无此人条目，对手方收录。

claim: Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya：约1325年；新正理奠基；《真理如意珠》；辩护非决定感知；tātparya 纳入认证因果链；tarka 反怀疑论。
locator: IEP 导言：'The school would enter its "new" phase (navya-nyāya) in the work of the eminent epistemologist Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya (c. 1325).'；SEP epistemology-india 论 Gaṅgeśa 对 indeterminate perception 的辩护、tātparya 与 tarka argument against skepticism 各段
note: 生卒与成书年份无直接系年（evidenceLimits 第7条）。

claim: 乔答摩—伐差耶那：注疏传统开端，现存最古注疏。
locator: SEP：'Vātsyāyana (fourth century, whose Nyāya-sūtra commentary is the oldest extant)'；IEP：'Throughout much of Nyāya's formative period the philosophical development of the school took place through commentaries on the sūtras'
note: 注疏关系为来源明载。

claim: 陈那—乌地衍那：乌地衍那吸收陈那学说并把伐差耶那的非正式推理形式化；整合第二、三检验为'知遍'。
locator: SEP epistemology-india §5：'Uddyotakara in his Nyāya-sūtra commentary incorporates Dignāga's ideas to formalize many of Vātsyāyana's informal inferences. The Nyāya philosopher owes almost everything to his Buddhist adversaries... but he does criticize and alter what he sees as the certification conditions of inference..., combining Dignāga's second and third tests into a...'
note: 阅读/批判关系，非师承。

claim: 陈那—法称：前后相继的佛教逻辑两大坐标。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Dignāga (sixth century) and Dharmakīrti (early seventh century)'（并列表述）；'Dharmakīrti classified inferences based on the ontological nature of the class-inclusion relationship that underpins all inference as a knowledge source.'
note: 师承细节不在来源内，relation 用'前后相继/接受发展'措辞。

claim: 法称—后出正理（此处落 Gaṅgeśa 一系）：两套比量分类的对照。
locator: SEP epistemology-india §5（第二轮缓存逐字核对）：'Later Nyāya divides inferences not according to the ontology of pervasion... but rather by the way a pervasion is known: anvaya-vyatireka ("positive and negative")... kevala-anvaya ("positive only")...'；'Dharmakīrti divides inferences into three kinds: sva-bhāva... tad-utpatti... anupalabdhi...'
note: 学派层面对照，标为编辑比较，不写成个人论战。
uncertainty: 整句与词列均已在缓存文本逐字核对（第二轮）。

claim: Udayana—Gaṅgeśa：旧正理向新正理的过渡（合流11—12世纪，Gaṅgeśa 约1325年奠基）。
locator: IEP：'The school would enter its "new" phase (navya-nyāya) in the work of the eminent epistemologist Gaṅgeśa Upādhyāya (c. 1325).'；SEP early-modern-india：'at some point in the 11th or 12th century, they merged to form a new school'
note: 发展阶段关系，非师承。
uncertainty: Gaṅgeśa 与合流的直接衔接细节不在来源内。

claim: 正理史前史与论辩—推理规则传统（vāda-śāstra）相连。
locator: IEP 导言：'Nyāya's prehistory is tied to ancient traditions of debate and rules of reasoning (vāda-śāstra).'
uncertainty: 该传统的具体年代不在来源内，节点不系年。

claim: 《正理经》编成约公元1—2世纪（来源分歧）。
locator: 同 overview 第2条 locator（'c. 200 C.E.' / 'c. 100 C.E.' 两处逐字）
note: 站内旧系年'公元前300'见 evidenceLimits 第9条。
uncertainty: 两来源年代不一致，照实并列。

claim: 伐差耶那《正理经注》：现存最古注疏，4世纪（一说约450）。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Vātsyāyana (fourth century, whose Nyāya-sūtra commentary is the oldest extant)'（逐字）；IEP 导言：'Leading commentators include Vātsyāyana (c. 450)...'（逐字）

claim: 6世纪陈那三相检验确立。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Dignāga (sixth century)' 与 'Dignāga laid out all the possible relationships of inclusion and exclusion for the extensions of two terms called the prover or "sign," hetu, and the probandum, sādhya'（逐字）
note: 节点类型标'论辩节点'（对正理形成的外部刺激）。

claim: 约600年乌地衍那《正理广注》。
locator: IEP 导言：'Uddyotakara (c. 600)'（逐字，见'Leading commentators'句）；SEP epistemology-india：'Uddyotakara in his Nyāya-sūtra commentary incorporates Dignāga's ideas...'（逐字，见 thinkers/2 locator 全句）

claim: 7世纪初法称按本体标准重分推理。
locator: SEP epistemology-india：'Dharmakīrti (early seventh century)'（逐字）；'Dharmakīrti divides inferences into three kinds: sva-bhāva ... tad-utpatti ... anupalabdhi'（逐字，全句见 thinkers/6 locator）

claim: 约875年 Jayanta《正理蔓》；同代有'稍异端的'Bhāsarvajña。
locator: IEP 导言：'important exceptions including works of Jayanta, c. 875, Udayana, c. 975, and the somewhat heterodox Bhāsarvajña, c. 875'

claim: 约900年 Vācaspati Miśra《Tātparyaṭīkā》；约975年 Udayana《正理花束》。
locator: IEP 导言：'Leading commentators include Vātsyāyana (c. 450), Uddyotakara (c. 600) Vācaspati Miśra (c. 900) and Udayana.'；IEP Sanskrit Source Materials 节："Vācaspati Miśra's Tātparyaṭīkā [cited as NVT]"；Udayana 设计论式见引语卡 locator（Nyāyakusumāñjali, Fifth Chapter）

claim: 11—12世纪正理与胜论合流为新正理；增'非存在'为第七范畴。
locator: 同 overview 第8条 locator（三处逐字）

claim: 约1325年 Gaṅgeśa《真理如意珠》奠基新正理；后于 Raghunātha、Jagadīśa、Gadādhara 达高峰；17—18世纪出简化手册。
locator: 同 thinkers/7 locator（IEP）；SEP early-modern-india：'Gaṅgeśa's brilliant and innovative Jewel of Reflection on the Truth (Tattvacintāmaṇi)'；'its heights with the works of Raghunātha, Jagadīśa and Gadādhara'；'in the 17th and 18th centuries, several manuals or compendia were written to explain in simplified language the basic tenets of the school... Annambhaṭṭa's The Manual of Reason (Tarkasaṃgraha...)'
uncertainty: Gaṅgeśa 与诸高峰人物的具体生卒不在来源内。

claim: 正理=推理的规则或方法。
locator: IEP 导言首句：'Nyāya (literally "rule or method of reasoning")...'

claim: 量：知识来源，亦是争论的最终裁决标准；乌地衍那以诸量并用为最强证明。
locator: IEP §1：'the pramāṇas are not simply the means by which individuals attain veridical cognition. They are also the final court of appeals in philosophical dispute. Uddyotakara thus claims the best kind of demonstrative reasoning occurs when the pramāṇas are deployed in concert...'

claim: 现量：NS 1.1.4 四条件定义；'诸量之长'；觉知（anuvyavasāya）归入感知（以 manas 为器官）。
locator: 同 overview 第4条 locator；觉知段：'Apperception is subsumed by Nyāya into the category of perception. In this case, the operative sense faculty is the "inner organ" (manas)...'

claim: 比量：以遍充（vyāpti）为枢纽；乌地衍那以'知遍'为成立条件；正理按遍的认识方式分类。
locator: IEP §1.b（Structure of Inference 节；五支例与 concomitance 表述）；SEP epistemology-india（第二轮缓存逐字核对）：Uddyotakara 'combining Dignāga's second and third tests into a single requirement, knowledge of pervasion'；'Later Nyāya divides inferences not according to the ontology of pervasion... but rather by the way a pervasion is known: anvaya-vyatireka... kevala-anvaya...'

claim: 五支论式：宗—因—喻—合—结及标准例。
locator: IEP §1.b.ii 五支例全文（'There is fire on the hill (the pratijñā, thesis)...' 至 'Thus, there is fire on the hill (the nigamana, conclusion).'，逐字）

claim: 譬喻量：NS 1.1.6 定义与'水牛似牛'词义习得例；自成一类的量。
locator: IEP §1.c：'Nyāya-sūtra 1.1.6 defines analogy as follows. Analogy makes an object known by similarity with something already known.'；水牛例：'...he recognizes that the thing he is seeing is similar to a cow, and therefore is a water buffalo.'；'Nyāya contends that the cognition in question is sui generis analogical'

claim: 圣言量：NS 1.1.5'合格说话者的断言'；āpta 双重资格；听者无需先行证明其可靠；非推理性质。
locator: IEP §1.d：'Testimony is the assertion of a qualified speaker.'；'Vātsyāyana claims that an āpta possesses direct knowledge of something, and a willingness to convey such knowledge without distortion (NB 1.1.7).'；'Nor does a hearer need positive evidence of trustworthiness.'；SEP：'The conditions that determine inferential knowledge and those that determine verbal knowledge are not the same.'（Jayanta）

claim: 十六句义：《正理经》开篇十六论题、四组。
locator: 同 overview 第3条 locator
note: 名目不逐项列举（evidenceLimits 第2条）。

claim: 似因：'貌似能立者'，形式谬误与假前提皆因导向假认知而入此列。
locator: IEP §1.b.iii：'Both formal fallacies and the inclusion of false premises lead to hetv-ābhāsa ("pseudo provers" or logical defeaters), since they engender false cognition.'；SEP：'Classical Indian philosophers are not focused on logic per se, but rather on a psychological process'

claim: 限定（avacchinna）：新正理分层处理属性出现位置的技术；定义即'区分性标记'。
locator: SEP early-modern-india §8.3（第二轮缓存逐字核对）："'the occurrence, of the property being-in-contact-with-the-monkey in the tree, is delimited by (avacchinna) the branch'"；§1.1：'The heart of this method lies in the use it makes of definitions, conceived of as differentiating marks of the thing defined.'（逐字）
note: 第二轮复核发现初稿中译'与枝相触的出现，被枝所限定'误置例句对象（原例是'与猴相触'的属性在树中被枝限定），已改正如现文。
uncertainty: 例句已整句逐字核对（第二轮）。

locator: 各条 locator 见 overview/thinkers 各条；经文小节号均出自两 SEP/IEP 条目的明确标注（如 'Nyāya-sūtra 4.2.26–36'、'4.2.42'、'4.2.44-5'）
note: 归名性质与年代分歧已写入 desc。

locator: SEP：'Vātsyāyana (fourth century, whose Nyāya-sūtra commentary is the oldest extant)'；SEP NB 2.1.20 段：'expressly rebuts the regress charge (we do sometimes certify our claims without having to certify the certifiers) under Nyāya-sūtra 2.1.20'；IEP NB 1.1.1/1.1.7 两处（见引语卡与 thinkers/1 locator）

claim: 《正理广注》（Nyāya-vārttika）：乌地衍那注；载宽容规则与 NV 4.1.21 设计论式。
locator: IEP Sanskrit Source Materials："Uddyotakara's Vārttika [cited as NV]"；NV 4.1.21 与宽容规则见 thinkers/2 与引语卡 locator
note: 题名中文'正理广注'为本包编辑意译（vārttika 释/广注），已注明性质。

claim: 《正理蔓》：约875年，独立著述；NM 322 推理/言语条件之别。
locator: 同 thinkers/3 locator；IEP Sanskrit Source Materials：'Jayanta Bhaṭṭa. Nyāya-mañjarī. Translated by Janaki Vallabha Bhattacaryya.'

claim: 《正理花束》：Udayana 第五品设计论式。
locator: IEP：'(Udayana Nyāyakusumāñjali, Fifth Chapter)'（kāryatvāt 论式全句见 thinkers/4 locator）

claim: 《真理如意珠》：Gaṅgeśa 新正理奠基作，按四量分四部分；后世集中于第二部与遍充。
locator: IEP（新阶段句，见 thinkers/7）；SEP early-modern-india：'Gaṅgeśa's brilliant and innovative Jewel of Reflection on the Truth (Tattvacintāmaṇi)'；§8.1：'Gaṅgeśa's Tattvacintāmaṇi is divided into four parts, one for each of the four knowledge-sources or pramāṇas recognised by the Nyāya school.'；'post-Gaṅgeśa scholars focused more and more exclusively on the second part, concerning inference'

claim: 《推理撮要》（Tarkasaṃgraha）：Annambhaṭṭa 17—18世纪简化手册；绰号'初学者的 Gadādhara 指南'。
locator: SEP early-modern-india：'...in the 17th and 18th centuries, several manuals or compendia were written to explain in simplified language the basic tenets of the school. I will describe the philosophical principles of Navya-Nyāya based on a synopsis of the most successful of these, Annambhaṭṭa's The Manual of Reason (Tarkasaṃgraha...)'；'This text was nicknamed Bāla-gādādharī, a sort of "Beginners Guide to Gadādhara".'
note: 题名中文为编辑意译（The Manual of Reason 之意）。

claim: 早期正理：经与注疏传统为主干，独立著述为例外。
locator: IEP 导言（formative period through commentaries 句与 Jayanta/Udayana/Bhāsarvajña 例外句，见 timeline/6 locator）

claim: 新正理：合流而成；承胜论形而上学与正理量论；技术语言与高峰人物、手册。
locator: SEP early-modern-india 导言合流句与 'Despite its name, Navya-Nyāya incorporates and develops classical Vaiśeṣika metaphysics as well as classical Nyāya epistemology'（第二轮缓存逐字核对）；第七范畴句逐字（见 overview/8）；Gaṅgeśa 新阶段句（IEP，逐字）

claim: 正理自然神学：设计论式传统，论敌为佛教徒与弥曼差派。
locator: IEP：'Nyāya thinkers were also India's most sophisticated natural theologians.'；'Nyāya primarily employs versions of the design inference.'；论敌句：'in constant engagement with sophisticated philosophical atheists, most notably Buddhists and Mīmāṁsakas (Hindu Ritualists)'；Uddyotakara/Udayana 论式见 thinkers/2、4 locator

claim: 论辩术前史（vāda-śāstra）：正理论辩规则的源头；方法影响文学批评与法理论。
locator: IEP：'Nyāya's prehistory is tied to ancient traditions of debate and rules of reasoning (vāda-śāstra).'；'Nyāya's methods of analysis and argument resolution influenced much of classical Indian literary criticism, philosophical debate, and jurisprudence.'

claim: 卷首引语为 NS 1.1.4 现量定义（Dasti 英译回译，paraphrase）。
locator: IEP §1.a：'Nyāya-sūtra 1.1.4 defines perceptual cognition as follows. A perceptual cognition arises by means of the connection between sense faculty and object, is not dependent on words, is non-deviating, and is determinate.'（逐字）

claim: 伐差耶那 āpta 界定（SEP 英译之下回译）。
